t: Agent entry points turn observed surfaces into frame-bound proposals; tools.propose returns admission, while tools.wait_verify waits for a separately validated receipt. Admission alone is not completion.

mw_run separates stored MemoryWeb workflows from browser goals and Host program goals. It rejects mixed selectors, incomplete focused-key requests and insufficient text steps before invoking the host runner.

mvctl defaults to the closed current tool interface: observe, list, propose, wait-verify, record-start and record-stop. Socket, session, agent/core identity and byte/time caps are mandatory; payload shape and version are checked before connection.

MCP exposes mv_observe, mv_list, mv_propose and mv_wait_verify only. Its standard-library stdio bridge validates closed arguments, requires initialization for protocol calls, and delegates to synchronous tools; it does not grant admission itself.

CoreClient checks an absolute Unix socket path, owner-only directory/socket modes and matching peer uid through SO_PEERCRED before sending. Inference: uid checks alone do not establish containment from compromised same-user processes.

Without MV_CORE_CONFIG the host backend discovers the unique same-uid packaged adapter whose parent is the packaged app. Missing or ambiguous candidates refuse MW_RUN_ATTACH. Discovery overwrites XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and requires the app configuration; conflicts in other copied keys refuse. Explicit MV_CORE_CONFIG selects environment attachment.

MemoryWeb home is private local data, not a browser profile. Its admission rejects tracked paths, symlinks, nested repositories, profile names or SQLite headers, unsafe ownership/modes and resource-limit violations. The entry admits the home before connecting to core.

tools/mw_home_check.py accepts --repo, optional --home and --workflow SITE/WORKFLOW; it checks git tracking/ignore state or packaged admission, then ensures and inspects the home before workflow provenance checks.

Corpus pins the Wender bundle digest, checks schema projections against that bundle, requires canonical JSON and matching site/workflow identities, and records hashes of the workflow and site.json. Artifact checks fail when these pinned definitions change.

Stored MemoryWeb workflow execution needs the locked Wender source interface: wender_api explicitly refuses a wender-runtime distribution with MW_COMPILED_WORKFLOW_UNAVAILABLE. This is distinct from compiled browser state/stopstate entry support.

ReplayOwner replay mode requires affirmative fixtures_offline proof. Site mode accepts a declared open, allowlisted/proxied or legacy network context and rejects a changed declaration. Missing backend evidence refuses MW_NETWORK.

ReplayOwner requires a matching acknowledged mode/network notice, elapsed minimum notice, no capsule restart permission and no outstanding write-approval requirement. Send preparation rechecks ownership, then paces, then reacquires observations before input intent.

Stored workflows must have supported coordinate actions and predicates, nonempty postconditions, valid slot bindings and verifiers returning Truth.TRUE. wait_signal, direct type steps, fallback targets, repeat/when branches and unsupported target forms refuse admission to this owner; private paste slots take the checked type path.

ReplayOwner.sense matches the observed frame reference with surface/digest/generation witness fields and binds the element table by its frame digest. A generation regression or changed digest at equal generation refuses MW_STALE_PUBLICATION. State validation and stop detection precede target use.

project_element_table accepts raw C2 only with the matching frame digest, or normalized vision retaining its in-process binding; it validates geometry and projects an integer-score element table. Unbound normalized dictionaries refuse identity_mismatch.

An explicitly selected compiled runtime checks its component commit against deps.lock and every regular payload file against compiled.lock.json. Symlinks, extra or missing files and wrong hashes refuse; explicit unusable runtime selection does not fall back to a source checkout.

The local planner grounds a click in a selected element-table box and rechecks the response against the frame, element ordinal, role/name and reconstructed state. A planner response does not authorize native input.

verify.run_loop observes, plans, submits once and waits within a shared deadline. The configured Wender path requires perception evidence and a locked component; it is an optional integration path, not a claim that any language-model output is trusted.

AdmittedExecutor validates the admitted verdict and proposal-id binding before transport, requires focus and an input timestamp, and strips transport fields that could pretend to grant verification authority. Target custody rejects changed or ambiguous nodes.

ReplayOwner.send requires a fresh send observation, core admission and a verified receipt correlated with proposal, surface, focus, input time and after-frame digest. Receipt mismatch stops progress; retained evidence excludes arbitrary backend fields and private text.

tools.wait_verify validates the expectation locally but the frozen wait call transmits only proposal_id and timeout_ms. It polls pending results within the monotonic budget without resubmitting the action, and distinguishes failed verification from timeout.

Workflow final success requires all nonempty postconditions to be freshly acquired as true. execute validates persisted summary bytes against the returned summary and pinned run schema, then runs the gate; a verified input receipt is not by itself workflow success.

HandoffLatch detects a stop receipt or an explicit observed login/captcha wall, latches before writing, and stores only surface, step, reason, confidence and evidence kinds. Persistence failure cannot reopen the run. The owner returns HUMAN_HANDOFF and does not resume that owner.

Browser goal execution builds actionable targets from native state, grounds a selected click, and binds typing to a uniquely focused native editor. Exact text readback reacquires observations without repeating input; an optional Enter is sent only after readback succeeds.

Host program text dispatch separates core verification from text certification: exact readback yields verified_text, unavailable certification yields uncertified_text, and mismatching text refuses MW_PROGRAM_TEXT_MISMATCH. This path does not prove application-task completion.

MuseProgramPlanner.selected_name refuses need_reasoning, supplied confidence below the configured threshold, invalid click schema, absent or ambiguous marks and mismatching element-table rows. Missing confidence is permitted by the code; the schema, mark, table-row and coordinate checks still apply.

External Wender, vision-engine and OpenSuperficies sources remain private; judges may evaluate the supplied compiled forms under NOTICE-EVALUATION.md. Public adapters and locks document boundaries, not private implementation or broader redistribution rights.

test_mcp_server uses a fake tools boundary to check the closed inventory, invalid argument rejection, typed refusals and protocol framing. It proves bridge behavior, not a live core socket or a model-driven desktop task.

EntryTests checks accepted and rejected mw_run flag combinations with an injected runner, and ensures an unsafe profile-bearing home is refused before core connection. These are parser/order tests, not live native input acceptance.

asm_web_memoryweb_hosted.test.js uses the real locked Wender runner with HostedWebCapsuleFake and HostedCoreAdmissionFake. It asserts workflow completion and receipt counts, schema/unsupported-action refusal, mismatch fencing, private text and absorbing wall handoff. Hosted RPC is not proof of a live browser or native core.

HandoffTests reuses the owner fixture and injected observations to check private handoff records, absorbing latching, no next proposal after verified input, and stops before intent or after pacing. Fixture detection coverage does not establish behavior on every real login screen.

Focused Host program key delivery records operator_asserted_focus and gameplay_verified=False alongside its native receipt. It proves delivery/verification evidence, not that a game objective was achieved.
